items.exampleEn: The company's name is in a prominent place on the building.
items.exampleZh: 公司名稱放在大樓顯眼的位置。

items.exampleEn: She resembles her mother very much.
The phone rang repeatedly during the meeting.
Her cooking is far superior to mine.
It was evident that she was tired.
The flight was delayed because of a mechanical problem.
items.exampleZh: 班機因為機械問題延誤了。

items.exampleEn: The magazine has an exclusive story about the famous singer.
items.exampleZh: 這本雜誌有一篇關於那位名歌手的獨家報導。

items.exampleEn: Rice is commonly eaten in Asia.
items.exampleZh: 在亞洲，人們普遍吃米飯。

items.exampleEn: Wash this delicate shirt by hand.
items.exampleZh: 這件細緻的襯衫要用手洗。

items.sentenceEn: The two brothers resemble each other in many ways.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩兄弟在很多方面都很像。

items.audioEn: The machine stopped because of a mechanical problem, so the workers went home early.
items.audioZh: 機器因為機械問題停了，所以工人提早回家。

items.sentenceEn: These glasses are delicate, so please carry them carefully.
items.sentenceZh: 這些玻璃杯很容易碎，請小心拿。

items.sentenceEn: It is evident that the plan needs more time.
items.sentenceZh: 很明顯這個計畫需要更多時間。

items.stemEn: I have ____ asked him to turn down the music, but he never listens.
items.stemZh: 我一再請他把音樂關小聲，但他從來不聽。

items.stemEn: This beach is ____ to hotel guests; other people can't use it.
items.stemZh: 這片海灘是飯店房客專用的，其他人不能使用。

items.passageEn: Mr. Ho's small watch shop is in a prominent place on Main Street. His old mechanical watches are commonly seen as works of art. Some of them are very delicate, so he repeatedly tells visitors not to touch them. Many customers say his watches are superior to new ones. One of them even resembles a small bird. The shop also sells an exclusive watch that Mr. Ho makes annually. It is evident that he loves his work.
items.passageZh: 何先生的小鐘錶店位在大街上顯眼的位置。他的老式機械錶通常被看作藝術品。其中有些非常脆弱，所以他一再提醒訪客不要去碰。很多客人說他的錶比新錶還好。其中一支甚至長得像一隻小鳥。店裡也賣一款獨家手錶，何先生每年做一次。很明顯，他熱愛自己的工作。

questions.questionZh: 何先生為什麼一再提醒訪客不要碰手錶？
關於何先生，文章說了什麼？

referenceEn: It is evident that he doesn't want to go.
It's evident that he does not want to go.
rubricZh: It is evident that＋子句，表示「很明顯⋯」
子句主詞是「他」，否定要配合第三人稱單數（例如 doesn't want to go、does not want to go）
寫 It is clear that… 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 這個小鎮很像一座歐洲的老城市。
referenceEn: This town resembles an old European city.
This small town resembles an old city in Europe.
rubricZh: 用 resemble 表示「像」，後面直接接名詞（例如 resembles an old city；寫 looks like 也正確）
「歐洲的老城市」可寫，例如 an old European city、an old city in Europe 等
